hypotheses.causal_mechanism: Derived from TRAIN diagnosis showing median SL=2.38 USD lets taker fees eat 56-83% of risk. Requires structural SL >= 4.00 USD, SL >= 1.25 * M1_ATR_14, and as-of M15 trend agreement.
hypotheses.falsification_rule: Falsified if R2 strict DEV gate fails on 1x/fee-only/2x, strict CI, Holm m=3, controls, or forward-only WF.

hypotheses.causal_mechanism: Waits 1..6 strictly closed M1 bars for directional close breakout beyond base trigger bar without hitting SL, then re-risks causally at new close and enters on the NEXT open (never OPEN_TO_OPEN).
hypotheses.falsification_rule: Falsified if R2 strict DEV gate fails or fails to beat NULL / placebo / time-shift.
hypotheses.observable_at: new_decision_timestamp_ms = bars_1m[idx + wait_bars].close_time > base_decision_ts; fill on bar[idx + wait_bars + 1].open

hypotheses.causal_mechanism: Derived from TRAIN diagnosis showing median TP=24.05 USD (8.92x SL) causes 43.9% of losses to reach >=1.0x SL favorably before stopping out. Selects nearest strictly as-of unswept M5 swing satisfying net_rr >= 2.0 on exact same entry/SL (fallback to baseline R2 target).
hypotheses.falsification_rule: Falsified if paired/1-pos replay fails R2 strict DEV gate or fails to beat controls.
